beats.label: The study
beats.text: Johns Hopkins tracked **995** adults over **65** for about **10** **years.**
beats.note: Jiang, Spira et al., J. Gerontology: Medical Sciences 2026

beats.label: Finding 1
beats.text: Napping **most** **days** was linked to about **48%** higher dementia risk.

beats.label: Why it might happen
beats.text: Researchers think frequent dozing may be an **early** **sign** of brain changes, not the **cause.**

beats.label: Reality check
beats.text: A **link,** not proof, based on **self-reported** naps. Suddenly dozing a lot? Worth **mentioning** to your doctor.
Follow for **sleep** **science** you can actually use.
